subject: LAB-030
check: Clean three-cue replay, muted live Mac adapter, and sequential rate/fatigue boundaries

provenance.sourceRevision: 4a7385871b1fc79af46dac272f1f9595efc635a9 + uncommitted LAB-030-B tests (committed unchanged as e75c668)

steps: Fresh engines: all three standard unavailable and muted cues; identical request retry; reset
Stand-in actuator and injected clock: minimum gap minus 1 ms and exact gap for each cue; fifth/sixth play; fatigue window minus 1 ms and exact window
Existing tests: denial, invalid IDs, reused ID with changed payload, Stop cancellation, reset isolation
LiveTactileGrammar.makeEngine on Mac: all three cues muted, Stop, reset

outcome.detail: 19 tests passed, including the three parameterized rate cases. All six clean replay cues returned their original visual/spoken values without audio; retries matched and each reset cleared three receipts. Rate and fatigue boundaries matched. Live Mac probe: Core Haptics false, controller false, Watch false, quiet audio true. All three muted live-adapter requests completed on the visual route without output.

limitations: Fixture path on Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0 (26A425), Swift 6.4. No actuator, speaker, microphone, network, or physical-device output was started.
No physical iPhone, Watch, or controller output; no rendered UI or assistive-technology run. Spoken is receipt text, not observed speech.
Sequential limiter and completed-request replay only; concurrent in-flight admission is unqualified. Reset holds no collection store; no imported user data was accessed.
